findings.evidence: `grep -n 'Layer [0-9]' code/EpsilonEridani` matches only this file; the labels come from roadmap README §0.1/§0.2.
findings.fix: Delete every "Layer 0.x" label; keep the mathematical content (e.g. section header "## The diffractive invariants", "## The target-elastic boundary in `t`"). Roadmap attribution stays in the PR description's `Roadmap:` line.
findings.issue: Roadmap layer numbers in documentation: module title "(Layers 0.1 and 0.2)" (line 11), section headers (lines 31, 87), and declaration docstrings prefixed "**Layer 0.1**"/"**Layer 0.2**" (lines 66, 76, 89, 104). These are PR/roadmap process, date badly, and nothing updates them when the roadmap is reorganised.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn 'Convention [0-9]' code/` returns no hits outside this file; the only definition is roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/Diffraction/README.md:112-116.
findings.fix: State the convention itself instead: "`t = Δ²` is the invariant momentum transfer to the target and is non-positive; `|t| = -t`."
findings.issue: "Convention 2" (lines 44, 52, 93) cites a numbered item in EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/Diffraction/README.md that does not exist anywhere in this repository; a reader of the file cannot resolve it, and the numbering shifts when the roadmap is edited.

findings.evidence: Lines 67-69, 78-80, 106 of the new file; the proofs are immediately below and already readable.
findings.fix: Replace each with what the statement says and what it is for — e.g. for `x_le_xi_of_beta_le_one`, that `x ≤ ξ` is the kinematic ordering of the inclusive and diffractive momentum fractions used to bound the diffractive region; drop the derivation sentences.
findings.issue: Three docstrings describe the proof rather than the result: `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` "the proof cancels the `P·q` shared by the two denominators" (lines 67-69), `x_le_xi_of_beta_le_one` "The bound is derived from the proved identity `x_eq_xi_mul_beta` together with ..." (lines 78-80), `tMinElastic_nonpos` "The expression ... is non-negative in the stated range, so its negative is ≤ 0" (line 106).

findings.evidence: Lines 97-99; roadmap README.md:299-301 defines `t_min(ξ, M, M_Y)` from the two-body threshold with the elastic case being the specialisation `M_Y = M`.
findings.fix: Say that `|t|_min` is obtained from the two-body threshold condition at fixed `(ξ, M, M_Y)` and reduces to `ξ²M²/(1-ξ)` when `M_Y = M`, and cite a standard diffractive-DIS kinematics reference in the file.
findings.issue: `tMinElastic`'s justification — "the minimum momentum transfer for a given `(M, ξ)` is achieved when the struck system is the massive target itself" — is inaccurate: target-elastic means `M_Y = M` by definition of the case, not a configuration that minimises anything; the true statement is that `|t|_min` increases with `M_Y`, so `M_Y = M` gives the smallest `|t|_min`. No reference is given for the "standard two-body kinematics" the formula is attributed to.

summary: The new file's docstrings are riddled with roadmap-process labels ("Layer 0.1/0.2", "Convention 2") that are unresolvable from the repository, and three declaration docstrings narrate their proofs instead of describing their results; one justification sentence for tMinElastic is inaccurate.
